title: Geulumbang Nyang Meubagi Darah .
intro: Bayangkan banjir nyang rayeuk that jiék ateueh darat, saboh Bahtera nyang meuapong teutap, dan saboh jiwa nyang jitinggai di luwa sabab jipiléh. Teuikat le darah keu sidroe nabi teuma teupisah le keuyakinan, tokoh nyoe geuhadapi panggilan akhe keu geujak u ateuh kapai watee ie meuluwah. Jeut neubuka identitas di likot penolakan nyan?
clues: Lon nakeuh keturunan salah sidroe nabi Allah nyang paleng rayeuk, rumoh tangga iman nyang lon pileh untuk lon tinggai.
Lon udep bak masa ie raya, watee kafir jitop nanggroe lagee ie.
Lon hana lontem ek Bahtera ngon ureung-ureung meuiman watee ayah lon geutawök lon.
Ulôn peugah lôn jak mita lindông bak saboh gunong keu teulindong droe nibak ié.
Ulôn geupeugah bahwa hana sapeuë njang ék peulindông nibak peuteuntèë Allah bak uroë njan keutjuali rahmat.
Lon ka jiteumeung le gelombang dan ka lhom, dan ayah lon jipeugah bahwa lon kon dari keuluarga gobnyan nyang jroh.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
